_read_me: TEMPLATE ONLY: contains no case data. Copy it into the restricted validation folder (never into the website repository), fill one object per case from the advisor's case input sheet, and run hc-harness.php on the copy.
hv00_reference: the reference of Legal/DPO's written HV-00 decision (for example an email or memo ID). The harness refuses to run without it.
key: HC-01 to HC-20 only. Do not enter names, PAN, Aadhaar, mobile, email, address, date of birth, employer, account, card or loan numbers, or UTRs (procedure section 4).
as_of: the closure date of the historical case (YYYY-MM-DD). Amounts must be as at that date.

Liability type: one of personal_loan, credit_card_outstanding, credit_card_emi, consumer_durable_loan, bnpl, education_loan, vehicle_loan, gold_loan, home_loan, loan_against_property, other_personal, unsecured_business_loan, secured_business_loan, msme_loan, nbfc_business_loan, business_term_loan, machinery_loan, commercial_vehicle_loan, cash_credit, overdraft, invoice_financing, merchant_financing, working_capital, other_business.
mode: full, partial (then fill partial_amount) or exclude.
Leave quoted_closure_amount null, so the engine's own estimate is compared with the lender's letter (procedure section 5).
Remove any field the document does not state, rather than guessing a value. Delete these _read_me lines and every _note field before running.

cases._note: Business case shape: use business_finances instead of individual_finances.
